summary: This informational document describes a well-known BGP community called BLACKHOLE for destination-based blackholing in IP networks. An origin AS can use it to ask a neighboring network to discard traffic destined to the tagged prefix, which is often used to limit damage from a denial-of-service attack.

eli5.summary: When a street is flooded with unwanted traffic, you can block it off. This defines a standard flag a network can attach to ask its neighbors to throw away traffic heading to a victim.
